_comment: Default safety rules for the AI Auto Optimizer. These are the FALLBACK — the live, admin-editable copy lives in the optimizer_settings DB row (13_advisor_optimizer_schema.sql), seeded from this file on first run. Editing this file changes the default for a fresh install only; changing behavior on a running platform means calling POST /api/v1/admin/optimizer/settings, which is itself logged. Every one of these is a HARD ceiling the optimizer's own code enforces in src/modules/optimizer — it is not a suggestion to a model, it's a check that throws if violated.
